title: Scheme-level generic splitting of a finite morphism
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian affine scheme and $g:Z\to S$ a finite morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There is a dense open $U$ of $S$ such that for every open $V\subseteq U$ there is a finite etale surjective morphism $p:T\to V$. On the fibre product $P=Z\times_S T$ [def-pc-fibre-product], using $T\to V\to S$, there are finitely many opens $W_i$ ($i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$) with union $P$ and pairwise disjoint underlying opens. Each composite $W_i\to P\to T$ is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. No sheaf occurs in the choice of $U$. The number $n$ may be zero.

source.place: ## Proof, finite-algebra calculation and final paragraph

proof.text: For A = Gamma(S,top) and B = Gamma(Z,top), the finite morphism gives affine Z and a finite A-algebra B by isAffine_of_isAffineHom and g.finite_appTop. Noetherianity gives IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian on the affine top open; integrality gives the domain instance. Apply exists_generic_finite_algebra_splitting to obtain c, A-prime, factors D_j and the reduced tensor algebra isomorphism. Convert each finite universally homeomorphic factor map to IsUniversalHomeomorphism: finiteness implies integrality, the identity base change gives surjectivity and all base changes are injective.

Apply finite_scheme_components_of_split_tensor_algebra to this supplied algebra data to obtain the cover and components over U = S.basicOpen c. Since S is reduced, basicOpen_eq_bot_iff and c != 0 prove U nonempty. Its openness and irreducibility of S prove density by IsOpen.dense.

For V <= U set a = S.homOfLE hVU, T-prime = pullback p a, and p-prime = pullback.snd p a. The proof constructs the source map k by pullback.lift, and proves the square with the source projections cartesian by IsPullback.of_bot. Define W-prime_j = k inverse-image W_j. The covering and disjointness assertions follow pointwise. Paste isPullback_morphismRestrict k (W_j) with this source pullback square; MorphismProperty.of_isPullback transfers each component universal homeomorphism. Finiteness, etaleness and surjectivity of p-prime are base-change instances. Return these witnesses.

lean.statement: theorem exists_dense_open_finite_scheme_splitting (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral S] [IsNoetherian S] [IsAffine S] {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ S) [IsFinite g] : ∃ U : S.Opens, Dense (U : Set S) ∧ ∀ (V : S.Opens), V ≤ U → ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (p : T ⟶ V.toScheme), IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ Surjective p ∧ ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → (pullback g (p ≫ V.ι)).Opens), (⨆ i, W i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (W i) (W j)) ∧ ∀ i, IsUniversalHomeomorphism ((W i).ι ≫ pullback.snd g (p ≫ V.ι))
